_comment_dropship_blinds: Dropship BLINDS bill to a per-province blinds customer (verified NetSuite names 'ON BLINDS ON LINE' etc., 2026-09-10). Dropship DRAPE PANELS keep the dropship_provinces (panels) customers above; DSD is drapery only. Tax always follows the province, never the product. Product is classified from the 850 vendor item number (app/products.py); Mixed/Unknown are skipped, not guessed.
_comment_customer_names: Display-only: NetSuite customer names by internal id, shown in the dashboard flyout so the blinds-vs-panels routing is verifiable at a glance. Read from NetSuite 2026-09-10.
_comment_product_items: Merchandise item by product. Dropship blinds book to the blinds item (its own revenue GL 40800 Sales: Blinds); drape panels + DSD (drapery) book to Drapery Panels (GL 40700). `item` above is the fallback for Unknown/unmapped.
_comment_amount_guards: SOFT per-channel gross bounds -- ADVISORY only, never blocks a push; flags outliers for review before they hit the GL. STARTER values with headroom over observed data (DSD ~$50-45k, dropship ~$10-3.6k as of 2026-09-10). Tighten to your risk tolerance.
_comment_discount: Vendor discount per Backward Calculator V5 (== HD Canada Invoice Allowance Spec). Booked in NetSuite as a percentage DISCOUNT item (itemType Discount) that carries the rate on the item itself; the connector emits one gross merchandise line + one discount-item line, both under the province tax code so NetSuite taxes the NET. DSD applies trade+IBx+RDC off gross and MET off the post-(trade+def+IBx) subtotal => 6.19% off gross (NetSuite item 194744, rate 6.19, verified 2026-09-09). Dropship drops freight+RDC => 5.19% (item to be created, rate 5.19). `rate` here must equal the NetSuite item's stored rate; it is used to compute the line amount (and drives the interim CSV path, which cannot recompute a percentage item).

dsd.note: Base price - (0.50% trade + 1.25% IBx + 1.00% RDC off gross) - 3.5% MET off subtotal = 6.19% off gross (Backward Calculator V5).

dropship.note: Base price - (0.50% trade + 1.25% IBx off gross) - 3.5% MET off subtotal = 5.19% off gross; drops freight + RDC (Backward Calculator V5).

_comment_ids: Internal NetSuite ids for the REST invoice connector. Read them from NetSuite with tools/netsuite_probe.py --type <recordtype> --id N (read-only). A blank value is reported by the push tool and BLOCKS a live send. Merchandise = NonInvtPart 194642 (Drapery Panels); DSD discount = Discount item 194744; dropship discount = Discount item 194745 (rate 5.19, contra-rev 49400).
_comment_sk_tax: SK is GST 5% + PST 6% = 11% (like QC's GST+QST 14.975%). CA-S-Sask (13713) is the NetSuite tax GROUP that bundles both; SK's tax_rate is 0.11 for our reconcile. The other 'CA-GST 5%' provinces (AB/BC/MB) may or may not carry PST -- verify each against the 810 before assuming; observed 2026-09: BC ties out at 5%, SK needed 11%.
_comment_class: NetSuite classification for HD Canada revenue = STOCK-PRODUCTS (id 7), created 2026-09-14. Distinguishes HD Canada stock products from OMIS cutdown (class 5 = OMIS-3DIF, which we must NOT reuse). Applied to the SO header (and invoice, if that path is ever used). Verified read-only: active, top-level; behaves like class 5 which is live on real SOs.
_comment_push: Which NetSuite record the connector creates. Accounting pivoted to Sales Orders (2026-09-11): their team converts SO -> invoice themselves, and an SO created in Pending Approval parks in an approval queue -- a human gate before anything posts to the GL. Flip record_type back to "invoice" to restore the direct-invoice path (custom_form_id above is the invoice form, 101).

sales_order._comment_order_status: A = Pending Approval. ONLY honored if SO approval routing is enabled in NetSuite; if it is OFF, NetSuite silently creates the SO as B (Pending Fulfillment). Confirm with accounting before the first live run.
sales_order._comment_custom_form: 102 = 'Custom Sales Order', the SAME form OMIS stamps on its own sales orders (accounting's request). Read off OMIS SO491442 (internal id 22694781) 2026-09-11: its OMIS-created SOs use customForm 102 and sit in orderStatus A / Pending Approval -- which also confirms SO approval routing IS enabled, so our order_status_id 'A' will be honored. (The invoice path used form 101.)

_comment_automation: Guards on the SCHEDULED push job ONLY (app.main._run_netsuite_push_job). Manual pushes from the dashboard/CLI are deliberately NOT limited by these -- a human can push anything, incl. pre-cutoff, on purpose. go_live_after: automation never pushes an invoice dated before this (positive cutoff). Set to 2026-09-11: everything dated 09/10 and earlier was already imported into NetSuite as invoices (149-incident + 09/10 test), so those are handled and their externalIds are already taken (an SO would collide) -- automation skips them entirely. max_per_run: if the post-cutoff, not-yet-pushed set exceeds this, the job REFUSES the whole run and logs 'blocked' rather than risk a blast (a day that large signals something unexpected, incl. the first catch-up run) -- review it and run manually from the app to override.
_comment_finale: Finale invoice creation (app.finale_invoice) -- ONE tool invoices BOTH DSD and Dropship, EDI-driven (850 product/810 qty+price), exact CRSTL discount + our tax, auto-POSTED when it ties to the 810 to the cent, left as a DRAFT + flagged otherwise. Finale invoices go nowhere downstream (internal record for teams without NetSuite). Ids read from the Finale catalogue 2026-09-15 (GET /api/productpromo, /api/taxauthorityrateproduct): promo presets DSD 100037 'DSD - 6.18875%', Dropship 100038 'Dropship - 5.18875%'; tax-rate products GST 5%=100000 (AB/BC/MB: we bill GST-only, no PST), HST 15%=100001 (NB/NL/PE), HST 13%=100002 (ON), GST+QST=100003 (QC), HST 14%=100004 (NS), GST+Sask PST=100005 (SK). enabled=false ships it OFF; the scheduled path is also capped by max_per_run and only ever invoices what the NetSuite push just sent.

finale._comment_nonedi: Non-EDI sale orders (HD Supply, Home Depot Special Orders, Chandos, Cressey, future OMIS commercial...) have no Crstl 850/810; accounting runs elsewhere (OMIS->NetSuite). app.finale_nonedi invoices them in Finale from the ORDER's own lines when SHIPPED in Finale, tax by the customer party's postal-address province, no discount, then completes the order. Classified by EXCLUSION (order id not a Crstl PO and saleSource not an EDI source) -- no customer list to maintain. nonedi_go_live_after is the floor on the Finale order date.
finale._comment_carriers: Carrier defaults per EDI channel (Ritchie, 2026-09-16): the ShipStation connection ships dropship shipments with NO carrier and the warehouse had to reopen/edit/re-complete each order to set Purolator; DSD pickups are keyed HDOC by hand. Names are matched exactly against Finale's Carriers list (Settings > Carriers, GET /api/partygroup groupName). ONLY the two EDI passes apply them -- DSD: written with PRO/RTS onto the open shipment before pickup; dropship (and DSD as fallback): written inside the invoice pass, in the reopen the engine already does. Non-EDI orders (HD Supply, Special Orders, ...) ship via a carrier TBD and are never touched. enabled=false ships it OFF: dry runs show which shipments would get which carrier; flip it after reviewing that list.
finale._comment_dsd_prefill: DSD pickups (2026-09-15): switched on/off from the dashboard Automation panel (setting auto_dsd_prefill_enabled, default off), not here. When on, the 15-min job copies PRO (bill_of_lading_number -> shipment trackingCode) and RTS (carrier_reference_number -> shipment publicNotes 'RTS ...') from each newly Accepted DSD 856 (Crstl flavor 'Direct Store Delivery (DSD)') onto the open Finale shipment of that PO, so the warehouse only types them once (in the ASN). The warehouse's manual 'Ship shipment' click at pickup stays -- it is the pickup confirmation. Same go_live_after floor, created_within_days window and max_per_run cap; one receipt per ASN (finale_shipments). Not reported in the digest.
finale._comment_auto_reopen: Ritchie's rule (2026-09-15): an order marked complete with no shipment or invoice is NOT complete. When true, the engines reopen such an order (edit -> lock, via its own action URLs) before invoicing; if it is still unshipped it stays open for the warehouse and is retried. false = report would_reopen in previews only.
finale._comment_stale_pickup: Digest Issues: an Accepted 810 still not shipped in Finale this many days after acceptance (DSD pickups always ship within 7 days; over 4 is trouble).
finale._comment_go_live_after: Finale's OWN positive floor (created_at, per the shared automation guard): the poll never considers an 810 created before this date, so enabling Finale invoicing only ever touches orders from this date forward -- history the warehouse invoiced by hand is out of scope by construction, not just by the existing-invoice skip.
